Strong working knowledge of secondary battery chemistries, degradation mechanisms, system architectures, and operational limitations across diverse duty cycles. Practical experience with balance-of-system (BOS) equipment, including inverters, medium-voltage transformers, combiner boxes, DC/DC converters, EMS, and BMS platforms. Working knowledge of grid connection and product compliance requirements applicable in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC, including Saudi Electricity Company grid connection requirements and SASO / GSO conformity schemes. Solid understanding of how energy storage and PV projects are constructed, commissioned, and brought online. Experience specifying or validating energy storage equipment for high-ambient-temperature environments. Ability to interpret operational data, apply statistical analysis techniques, and produce clear, actionable reports. Working knowledge of commercial contracts, performance guarantees, and how technical design and proposal assumptions must support contractual obligations. Familiarity with competitive energy storage products in the market and the ability to clearly articulate differentiated technical value. Proven ability to operate cross-functionally across engineering, product, sales, marketing, and field teams. Demonstrated ability to meet tight deadlines, manage multiple priorities, and maintain accountability for deliverables. Professional fluency in Arabic and English, written and spoken, with the ability to run technical discussions and present to customers in both languages. Based in Saudi Arabia and working remotely, with the right to work in the Kingdom. Willingness and ability to travel 10–20% to support customer engagement, project development, site validation, and industry events. You can move seamlessly between modeling software and a job site. Pre-Sales & Commercial Orientation: You understand that technical precision underpins revenue. Professional & Accountable: You meet commitments, communicate proactively, and maintain composure and clarity under tight timelines and high-stakes customer interactions. Ideal Mindset & Competencies Bridge Builder (Between Engineering and Revenue): They see themselves as a strategic enabler of growth. Their technical clarity accelerates deal cycles, increases win rates, and strengthens customer confidence. Application-First Thinker: They design around real operating profiles—capacity firming, arbitrage, peak shaving, resilience, grid services—ensuring systems are optimized for performance and economics. They are also a code master, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned with NEC, IEEE, UL, and applicable global standards. Commercially Fluent Engineer: They understand contracts, guarantees, liquidated damages risk, and bankability requirements—and ensure technical proposals align with those realities. Market-Aware Technologist: They track competitor capabilities and industry standards closely, positioning EnerVenue’s technology with precision and credibility. Disciplined Under Pressure: They thrive under deadlines, balancing technical thoroughness with commercial urgency, and consistently deliver high-quality work on schedule. Forward-Thinking & Creative: They anticipate evolving grid needs, emerging use cases, and new commercial models—bringing fresh thinking to how energy storage is designed, positioned, and deployed. You’ll lead suppliers and delivery partners, explore emerging AI capabilities and help us get the balance right between innovation, security and practical business value. Why EDF power solutions? We’re united by a shared ambition: to tackle climate change, shaping an Electric UK and Ireland. Our diverse team is growing fast, driven by innovation and a commitment to clean, green energy for all. You’ll be confident working across a complex organisation, managing external partners and influencing how AI is used safely and effectively. Knowledge of modern AI technologies, including large language models, generative AI and emerging AI capabilities. Experience working with stakeholders across different business areas, functions or geographical locations. Experience within energy, utilities or another large, complex organisation would be useful. What You’ll Be Doing Shaping and managing our AI strategy and roadmap, helping us decide where AI can make the biggest difference. Leading how our AI platform is used across the business, making sure it’s adopted safely, securely and appropriately. Managing specialist AI suppliers and delivery partners, making sure solutions meet our needs and deliver value. Working with IT colleagues across the UK and France to share expertise and make the most of capabilities from across EDF. Setting clear standards around responsible AI use, including security, privacy, data quality and governance. Taking AI opportunities from discovery through to delivery, adoption and ongoing improvement. Exploring emerging AI technologies and assessing where they can solve genuine business problems. Building relationships with senior stakeholders and helping teams understand what AI can, and can’t, do for them. Measuring adoption and value to make sure AI investments are delivering the outcomes we expected. Pay, Benefits And Culture If you’re looking to join a company where you can work hard, have fun, and help to create a net zero future – then you’re in the right place! Alongside a competitive salary and potential for an annual bonus, and a market-leading pension scheme, our employee benefits include flexible benefits tailored to your lifestyle – from electric vehicle leasing and private healthcare to extra holiday and more. review_candidates.description: Leader Clinics selecciona médicos/as especialistas en Radiodiagnóstico para residir y trabajar desde Bali, Indonesia, durante un mínimo de un año, dentro de un proyecto internacional de telerradiología. La actividad consiste en informar estudios de diagnóstico por imagen para hospitales privados de Europa, proporcionando cobertura a sus servicios de urgencias. La organización del trabajo aprovechará la diferencia horaria entre Bali y Europa para cubrir la actividad nocturna europea. Requisitos Titulación en Medicina y especialidad en Radiodiagnóstico, con formación especializada completada. Experiencia sólida en radiología de urgencias. Dominio del inglés para elaborar informes y comunicarse con los equipos clínicos. Certificación IELTS con puntuación global mínima de 7,5 u OET equivalente, con los requisitos por componente que exija la acreditación correspondiente. Disponibilidad para desplazarse y permanecer en Bali durante un mínimo de un año. Se valorará especialmente una amplia experiencia profesional y la subespecialización en Neurorradiología, Radiología Musculoesquelética o Radiología de Cuerpo. Se ofrece Incorporación a un proyecto internacional de telerradiología para hospitales privados europeos. El cliente se encargará de la tramitación y del coste del seguro de responsabilidad civil profesional correspondiente a la actividad. El cliente asumirá la tramitación y los costes de las acreditaciones y licencias profesionales necesarias para informar estudios de sus hospitales clientes, según los países de destino de los informes. Condiciones económicas, modalidad contractual, horarios y organización del desplazamiento a concretar durante el proceso de selección. Candidaturas Enviar CV actualizado, subespecialidad, experiencia en urgencias, certificación de inglés y disponibilidad a ricardosegui@leaderclinics.com
